description: Legacy development fields that the schema-1 pack vocabulary cannot express, in whole or in part, and the fields the development pack has come to carry. The parity comparison does not cover the residue. delivered is the part of the field the development pack carries, or null when it carries none of it. residue is what stays outside the pack, or null when the pack carries the whole field since GP-10B-2 PR 2. owner is the task that owns the residue next, or, for an entry with no residue, the task that delivered it. gp09Gap is the GP-09 vocabulary gap code that reports the field in a state that uses it. inDefaultState is true for a field observed in the default legacy state and false for a legacy field the default state does not use, listed so that its owner is on record.

entries.subject: agent
entries.reason: Whether the Runtime agent is enabled. A pack agent is a declaration and creates no Runtime agent.

entries.subject: task_kind
entries.delivered: All five routes, each as a task type of the workflow of that ID: `taskType` for feature, bugfix, research and release, and `additionalTaskTypes` for maintenance -> delivery.
entries.reason: Routing of a task kind to a pipeline. A pack workflow names one task type, so the second kind of a pipeline that routes two has no place in the pack.

entries.subject: pipeline
entries.delivered: Every task kind of each pipeline, as the task types of its workflow, including both task kinds of the delivery pipeline.
entries.reason: One pipeline routes several task kinds; a pack workflow names one task type.
